name: IceCube
summary: Cubic-kilometer neutrino observatory in ice, searching the Sun, Earth, Galactic center and halo for dark-matter neutrinos. DeepCore extends sensitivity to lower energies.
detection_principle: Charged particles from neutrino interactions emit Cherenkov light in ice; optical-module timing and light yield reconstruct tracks, cascades, energy and direction.

results.summary: Nine years of DeepCore data test Galactic-center dark-matter annihilation.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
